steps.name: Close station
steps.do: **Set transportation station as closed** for today.

steps.name: Map station closed
steps.do: On **Map**, set **Specific Map** to today. Select Zoomobile **Current Route**.
steps.expect: The closed station is not shown as an open station on the route.

steps.name: Map station open
steps.do: On **Map**, set **Specific Map** to today. Select Zoomobile **Current Route**.
steps.expect: The station closed in step 1 is shown on the route again.

steps.name: Set Summer route
steps.do: **Set current transportation route** — choose **Summer**, date range including today.

steps.name: Map summer
steps.do: On **Map**, confirm the Zoomobile **Current Route** / Summer treatment.

steps.name: Set Winter route
steps.do: Set route to **Winter** for a range.

steps.name: Map winter
steps.do: On **Map**, confirm the Zoomobile **Current Route** / Winter treatment.
steps.expect: Winter route stations differ from the summer route.

steps.name: Restore Summer route
steps.do: Set the transportation route back to **Summer** for a range including today. On **Map**, select Zoomobile **Current Route**.
steps.expect: Success that the transportation route was set to Summer. Summer route stations match step 6.
